petitioner.
Mr. Shobhit Saharia, Advocate for the THDC.
2. Petitioner was initially appointed as
Draftsman (Trainee) w.e.f. 16.11.1989 in Tehri
Hydro Development Corporation (THDC) India
Limited. At the time of his appointment, he
possessed certificate in Draftsman (Civil) trade
from an Industrial Training Institute. He was
subsequently promoted as Junior Supervisor
(Environment) on 16.03.2001; thereafter, he was
promoted to S-2 Grade in 2004, to S-3 Grade w.e.f.
2007, and further to S-4 Grade in 2009.
3. Because of change in Promotion Policy,
petitioner was considered for promotion to
Executive Cadre and permitted to participate in
promotional exercise held in 2017, and he was
promoted to E-1 Grade (Executive Cadre) in 2017.
4. Petitioner had made a representation to
permit him to participate in promotional exercise
for the post of Deputy General Manager (E-3), held
in 2021. His representation was rejected vide order
dated 18.06.2021 on the ground that qualification
possessed by him, is not as per Promotion Policy,
applicable in THDC.
5. By means of this writ petition, petitioner has

2026:UHC:3297
challenged result of DPC, declared on 17.07.2021,
and he has also challenged rejection of his
representation vide order dated 18.06.2021.
6. Learned counsel appearing for THDC,
however, refers to Annexure-1 to the Promotion
Policy, which is on record at page 28 of the writ
petition, for contending that one should possess
BE/B.Tech with M.Tech in Environmental
Engineering from recognized Indian University or
Institute recognized by appropriate statutory
authority/Doctorate for promotion beyond the post
of DGM.
7. He submits that petitioner does not possess
BE/B.Tech with M.Tech qualification and he relies
upon a mark sheet of M.Sc. obtained from Eastern
Institute for Integrated Learning and Management
(EIILM) University, Sikkim. He submits that since
petitioner obtained M.Sc. degree from that
University, through distance learning mode,
however, it is not known whether the Distance
Education Council has granted recognition to said
University for conducting M.Sc. degree through
distance learning mode.
8. He further submits that as per Annexure-1 to
the Promotion Policy, M.Sc. degree in
Environmental Science & Ecology has to be
obtained either in regular or part time mode, and
Annexure-1 is absolutely silent as regards distance
learning mode.

2026:UHC:3297
9. He further submits that petitioner has not
submitted M.Sc. degree with competent authority
in THDC and he has placed reliance upon the mark
sheet, alleged to have been issued by the aforesaid
University.
10. Learned counsel for the petitioner concedes
that M.Sc. degree was not supplied by the
petitioner to the competent authority in THDC.
11. The writ petition is, therefore, disposed of by
permitting petitioner to submit his M.Sc. degree
along with all relevant documents, as desired by the
employer, within two weeks from today. The
competent authority in THDC shall examine the
M.Sc. degree in Environmental Science & Ecology
of the petitioner and pass necessary order after
examining the validity of M.Sc. degree with
reference to Annexure-1 of Promotion Policy,
applicable in THDC, within four months thereafter.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 30.04.2026 Mahinder/
